name: Environmental Control Center
summary: Environmental Control Center Co.,Ltd. is a Japanese firm specializing in environmental consultancy. It offers comprehensive monitoring and advisory services concerning air, water, and soil quality, applicable to both general ecological systems and industrial settings. The company also provides a niche range of services focused on odors, including investigating unusual smells, evaluating the effectiveness of deodorizing products and equipment, managing odors within industrial and commercial spaces, ensuring product odor quality, and conducting odor assessments for new product development. Furthermore, they conduct detailed investigations and analytical work related to soil contamination, alongside providing expert guidance on remediation projects, navigating regulations, and managing information disclosure in this area. Their offerings extend to environmental impact assessments, encompassing initial consultations with regulatory bodies, conducting thorough environmental studies, drafting official assessment reports, carrying out follow-up evaluations, and engaging in subsequent discussions with authorities. Established in 1971, the company's main office is located in Hachioji, Japan.
